_note: Real 800 m standards for the season goals (GDD 4.9.2 'Season goals with times', session C5). Times in SECONDS (the game shows them as 2:21.00). Every set has a source (a PDF of Suomen Urheiluliitto, SUL) and the season it was published for; later seasons use the same table as an ESTIMATE (the new limits come out in February each year, so the game marks them 'estimated' after `valid`). sets.<id>: name / short = how the goal text names it; kind = what it is (entry = a limit to enter a championship, selection = a coach-group (Team Finland) selection criterion, open = a limit for a national championship); ages = who it applies to (the age the athlete turns in the year); times = key -> seconds, where the key is the gender letter (M / N) + the age or an age group. `times_from` = a path in another data file when the table already lives there (the SM 14-15 limits stay in competitions.json standards.sm_14_15 so the calendar and the race screen use the same numbers). `lookup` says how an athlete's key is made from the age: `age` = M15 / N15 (each age has its own), `group` = the first group whose ages contain it (M14-15, M16). `meet_ids` = the calendar meets the standard belongs to. All numbers copied by hand from the PDFs listed in `sources`; checked against the PDF pages on 2026-10-16.
